strings.brace-expansion: DoS via exponential-tim: brace-expansion：透過連續非展開的 {} 群組進行指數時間展開導致 DoS
strings.brace-expansion: DoS via unbounded expan: brace-expansion：因無邊界的展開長度導致記憶體不足的行程當機造成 DoS
strings.brace-expansion: DoS via unbounded inter: brace-expansion：透過無邊界的中繼陣列繞過 CVE-2026-14257 緩解措施導致 DoS
strings.brace-expansion: DoS via uncontrolled re: brace-expansion：因 parseCommaParts 中未受控的遞迴造成堆疊耗盡導致 DoS
brace-expansion：因巢狀大括號群組的未受控遞迴造成堆疊耗盡導致 DoS
